meta_title: Louis Whittaker Tree Services | Arborist Southampton
meta_description: Louis Whittaker Tree Services in Southampton. Expert tree surgery, felling, and crown reduction. Fast response, fully insured. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Qualified Arborist — Fully Insured Tree Work
hero_subhead: Dangerous tree hanging over your garden? We safely fell, prune, and remove trees across Southampton and New Forest, often the same week.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency felling to precision pruning, we handle every type of tree work safely and sustainably.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We dismantle large specimens in tight spaces and grind stumps completely — no mess left behind.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Thinning
services.desc: Reduce weight and improve light without damaging the tree. Perfect for overgrown oaks and conifers threatening fences or property.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Remove broken and hazardous branches that pose a risk to your home. Keeps trees healthy and your garden safe.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen or hanging trees blocking access? We respond quickly to storm damage, assess safety, and clear debris efficiently.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cutting keeps boundaries neat and promotes healthy growth. We handle everything from laurel to hawthorn.

services.title: Tree Surveys & Reports
services.desc: Professional arboricultural assessment for insurance, conveyancing, or planning permission. Full written report and recommendations provided.

about_pullquote: We started this because we hated seeing trees butchered by cowboys.
about_para_1: Louis Whittaker Tree Services has been removing and maintaining trees across Southampton, Netley, and the wider South Coast for nearly two decades. We're qualified arborists who take pride in working safely at height and leaving your garden in better shape than we found it. Every job is fully insured, and we carry professional certification in climbing and chainsaw operation.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest — we're the safest and most thorough. Local homeowners and businesses call us back because we always finish on time, clean up after ourselves, and give straight advice about what your trees actually need. If a tree can be saved, we'll save it. If it has to come down, we'll do it right.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak threatening the garage after the storm last month. Louis came round, assessed it properly, explained what needed doing, and gave a fair quote. The job was done in one afternoon — the team was professional and cleaned up every last branch. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our laurel hedge had completely gone wild and was blocking out all the light. Louis trimmed it back beautifully and it's already growing back thick. He's been back twice now for maintenance cuts. Reliable, friendly, and never overcharges.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Emergency call on a Saturday morning because a dead ash tree was leaning over my fence. Louis answered, came out the same day, and had it down and chipped by evening. Professionalism and speed — exactly what you want in a crisis. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert D.
